headlines.title: The Dallas Cowboys cheerleaders are unionizing
headlines.description: America’s highest-profile cheerleading squad has won a victory of its own: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders have formed a union.

headlines.title: Trump administration cancels some Canada tariffs amid close midterm races
headlines.description: Sen. Susan Collins, who’s in a tough re-election fight, said she secured from the Trump administration tariff exemptions on some agricultural and forestry items.

headlines.title: Goldman Sachs spends big to give small businesses an AI boost
headlines.description: The Wall Street giant is committing $500 million to expand its 10,000 Small Businesses program and launch an AI institute, partnering with Google, Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic to bring AI know-how to Main Street. NBC's Christine Romans spoke exclusively with Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon and with small businesses figuring out how to make AI work for them.

headlines.title: Money Conversations at Every Age: What to Discuss by Generation
headlines.description: From teens to aging parents, certified financial planner Ted Jenkin joins TODAY with the conversations every family should have at every age. He discusses teaching teens to read a paystub, helping adult children in their 20s and 30s build up their own credit, the documents aging parents should have in place and more.

headlines.title: iPhone Duo review: Is Apple's first foldable smartphone too expensive?
headlines.description: Apple will release the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone, this Friday. NBC News' chief technology analyst Joanna Stern reviews the new iPhone and its hefty price tag.

headlines.title: Fall Job Search Strategies to Add Some Extra Cash to Your Wallet
headlines.description: With the holidays approaching, some companies are looking to fill roles now and there are plenty of roles for part timers who just want a little extra money. NBC’s Vicky Ngyen joins TODAY to share why fall is the time to strike on a new career opportunity, tips to standout with recruiters, and more.

headlines.title: Etsy to restrict AI-generated content in effort to combat seller slop
headlines.description: Etsy announced new restrictions on AI-generated content on its platform, saying it threatens the integrity of sellers’ work and leaves buyers exposed to fraud.

headlines.title: Russian diesel tanker heads to the U.S., the first since Trump’s deal with Putin
headlines.description: A tanker loaded with diesel fuel set sail Friday from Russia for the United States, the first shipment since President Donald Trump agreed to a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to release more fuel into the global market.

headlines.title: Hackers appear to be struggling to exploit PHP flaws after global cybersecurity crisis
headlines.description: There were few, if any, reports of widespread damage by hackers exploiting PHP flaws, experts said, one day after officials warned of severe vulnerabilities.

headlines.title: On Main Street, Goldman Sachs makes a big bet on AI
headlines.description: The Wall Street giant says it’s teaming up with OpenAI, Google, Meta and Anthropic to help small businesses embrace artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Markets tumble as concerns about Iran war and high AI spending collide
headlines.description: Oil prices climbed to their highest levels since May, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq slid on fears that the capital funding the AI boom might be drying up.

headlines.title: Airbnb hosts can no longer ask guests to clean dishes or make beds
headlines.description: Customers don’t have “to complete tasks that require significant effort or time, or would typically be performed by a cleaner,” according to the home-sharing app.
